data.title: Future: docket deps impact <id> - show what completing a bug unblocks
data.body:
Show what completing a bug would unblock.

```
$ docket deps impact def2

Completing def2 would:
  
  Directly unblock:
    abc1: Implement user auth [Approved, P1]
  
  Transitively unblock:
    mno5: Add login page [Draft, P2]
    stu7: Add session management [Approved, P1]
    pqr6: Add OAuth support [Draft, P3]
  
  Total: 4 bugs unblocked (1 direct, 3 transitive)
  Bugs becoming ready: abc1
```

## Future idea

Only implement if users need to prioritize work based on downstream impact.
